                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">Vue3 + AI Agent 前端开发实战：一个 前端开发工程师的转型记录</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>6年 前端开发经验，1 年 AI 产品实战。从 Vue2 到 Vue3，从传统 Web 到 AI Agent，本文记录了我作为 Vue 前端工程师在 AI 产品开发中的技术选型、核心难点、解决方案，以及那些踩过的坑。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">前言</h3>
<p>我是一名"老 Vue"——从 2019 年开始用 Vue2，经历过 Options API 到 Composition API 的变迁，参与过多个大型 Vue 项目的架构设计。</p>
<p>2025 年，公司决定做 AI 产品线，我主动请缨负责 AI Agent 的前端开发。</p>
<p>刚开始我信心满满："Vue 我都玩得这么熟了，加个 AI 功能能有多难？"</p>
<p>结果第一个 sprint 就给了我当头一棒：</p>
<ul>
<li>流式响应和 Vue 的响应式系统怎么配合？</li>
<li>对话状态用 Pinia 还是用 Composition API？</li>
<li>AI 生成的 Markdown 内容怎么高效渲染？</li>
<li>长对话列表怎么用 Vue 实现虚拟滚动？</li>
<li>WebSocket 连接怎么在 Vue 组件中优雅管理？</li>
</ul>
<p>这篇文章，就是我这 1 年来的实战记录。如果你也是 Vue 开发者，想进入 AI 产品开发领域，希望我的经验能帮到你。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">一、技术选型：为什么是 Vue3？</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">1.1 团队背景</h4>
<p>我们团队的技术栈一直是 Vue：</p>
<ul>
<li>老项目：Vue2 + Vuex</li>
<li>新项目：Vue3 + Pinia</li>
<li>UI 框架：Element Plus</li>
</ul>
<p>如果为了 AI 产品专门换 React，学习成本太高。所以我决定：<strong>用 Vue3 做 AI Agent 前端</strong>。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">1.2 核心挑战</h4>
<p>AI 产品前端和传统 Web 应用的最大区别：</p>





























<table><thead><tr><th>传统 Web</th><th>AI Agent 前端</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>请求 - 响应模式</td><td>流式响应</td></tr><tr><td>状态变化可预测</td><td>AI 回复不确定</td></tr><tr><td>内容结构清晰</td><td>多模态内容（Markdown、代码、公式）</td></tr><tr><td>对话轮数有限</td><td>长对话性能优化</td></tr><tr><td>网络中断可重试</td><td>需要离线可用</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">1.3 最终技术栈</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-arduino" lang="arduino">Vue <span class="hljs-number">3.4</span> + Vite <span class="hljs-number">5</span> + Pinia + TypeScript
流式通信：SSE + WebSocket
Markdown 渲染：markdown-it + 自定义组件
虚拟滚动：vue-<span class="hljs-keyword">virtual</span>-scroller
状态管理：Pinia + Composition API
本地存储：<span class="hljs-built_in">IndexedDB</span> (idb-keyval)
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">二、核心难点与 Vue 解决方案</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">2.1 难点一：流式响应与 Vue 响应式配合</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong>
AI 的流式响应是增量更新的，而 Vue 的响应式系统适合整体更新。初期代码：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- ❌ 错误示范：每次更新都创建新数组 --&gt;
&lt;script setup&gt;
import { ref } from 'vue'

const messages = ref([])
const currentContent = ref('')

function handleStreamChunk(chunk) {
  currentContent.value += chunk
  // 问题：每次都创建新数组，性能差
  messages.value = [...messages.value.slice(0, -1), {
    role: 'assistant',
    content: currentContent.value
  }]
}
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>每次 chunk 都触发数组重新赋值</li>
<li>导致整个消息列表重新渲染</li>
<li>对话多了之后明显卡顿</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>解决方案：使用 shallowRef + 手动触发更新</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- ✅ 正确做法 --&gt;
&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
import { ref, shallowRef, triggerRef } from 'vue'

interface Message {
  id: string
  role: 'user' | 'assistant'
  content: string
  isStreaming?: boolean
}

// 用 shallowRef 避免深度监听
const messages = shallowRef&lt;Message[]&gt;([])
const streamingMessageId = ref&lt;string | null&gt;(null)

function handleStreamChunk(chunk: string) {
  const msgs = messages.value
  const lastMsg = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
  
  if (lastMsg &amp;&amp; lastMsg.id === streamingMessageId.value) {
    // 原地修改，不触发响应式
    lastMsg.content += chunk
    // 手动触发更新
    triggerRef(messages)
  } else {
    // 添加新消息
    messages.value = [
      ...msgs,
      {
        id: streamingMessageId.value!,
        role: 'assistant',
        content: chunk,
        isStreaming: true
      }
    ]
  }
}

function handleStreamComplete() {
  const msgs = messages.value
  const lastMsg = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
  if (lastMsg) {
    lastMsg.isStreaming = false
    triggerRef(messages)
  }
  streamingMessageId.value = null
}
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键点：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><code>shallowRef</code> 只监听第一层变化，避免深度遍历</li>
<li>原地修改数组元素，减少不必要的复制</li>
<li><code>triggerRef</code> 手动触发更新，控制渲染时机</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>性能对比：</strong></p>




















<table><thead><tr><th>方案</th><th>100 条消息</th><th>500 条消息</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>普通 ref</td><td>80ms</td><td>450ms</td></tr><tr><td>shallowRef + triggerRef</td><td>15ms</td><td>50ms</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">2.2 难点二：对话状态管理（Pinia vs Composable）</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong>
对话相关的状态很多：</p>
<ul>
<li>消息列表</li>
<li>加载状态</li>
<li>当前 Agent</li>
<li>Token 使用量</li>
<li>连接状态</li>
</ul>
<p>初期我用 Pinia 管理所有状态：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 问题：Store 变得很臃肿</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineStore } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'pinia'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useChatStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'chat'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> ({
    <span class="hljs-attr">messages</span>: [] <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Message</span>[],
    <span class="hljs-attr">isLoading</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentAgent</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Agent</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">tokenCount</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">connectionStatus</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'disconnected'</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ConnectionStatus</span>,
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 还有更多状态</span>
  }),
  <span class="hljs-attr">actions</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sendMessage</span>(<span class="hljs-params">content: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 逻辑越来越复杂</span>
    },
    <span class="hljs-title function_">handleStreamChunk</span>(<span class="hljs-params">chunk: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
    },
    <span class="hljs-title function_">connectWebSocket</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
    }
  }
})
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Store 文件超过 500 行，难以维护</li>
<li>WebSocket 逻辑和 UI 状态混在一起</li>
<li>难以复用（多个聊天窗口需要多个实例）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>解决方案：Composable + Pinia 混合方案</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 用 Composable 管理复杂逻辑</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// composables/useChatStream.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref, shallowRef, onUnmounted } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UseChatStreamOptions</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">onChunk</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">chunk: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">onComplete</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">onError</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">error: <span class="hljs-built_in">Error</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useChatStream</span>(<span class="hljs-params">options: UseChatStreamOptions</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isConnected = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isStreaming = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> error = ref&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> abortController = shallowRef&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">eventSource</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">EventSource</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">startStream</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, payload: <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span></span>) {
    abortController.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>()
    
    eventSource = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EventSource</span>(url)
    
    eventSource.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(event.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (data.<span class="hljs-property">done</span>) {
        options.<span class="hljs-title function_">onComplete</span>()
        eventSource?.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>()
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
        options.<span class="hljs-title function_">onChunk</span>(data.<span class="hljs-property">content</span>)
      }
    }

    eventSource.<span class="hljs-property">onerror</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'流式连接错误'</span>)
      options.<span class="hljs-title function_">onError</span>(error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
      eventSource?.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>()
    }

    isConnected.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
    isStreaming.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">stopStream</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    abortController.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
    eventSource?.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>()
    isStreaming.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
    isConnected.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 组件卸载时清理</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">onUnmounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">stopStream</span>()
  })

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    isConnected,
    isStreaming,
    error,
    startStream,
    stopStream
  }
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 用 Pinia 管理全局状态</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// stores/chat.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineStore } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'pinia'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ChatState</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">conversations</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Conversation</span>[]
  <span class="hljs-attr">currentConversationId</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">agents</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Agent</span>[]
  <span class="hljs-attr">tokenUsage</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">TokenUsage</span>
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useChatStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'chat'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: (): <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">ChatState</span> =&gt;</span> ({
    <span class="hljs-attr">conversations</span>: [],
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentConversationId</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">agents</span>: [],
    <span class="hljs-attr">tokenUsage</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">total</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">used</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">remaining</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span> }
  }),
  <span class="hljs-attr">getters</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentConversation</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> state.<span class="hljs-property">conversations</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">find</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">c</span> =&gt;</span> c.<span class="hljs-property">id</span> === state.<span class="hljs-property">currentConversationId</span>)
    }
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">actions</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">loadConversations</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/conversations'</span>)
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">conversations</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>()
    },
    <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">createConversation</span>(<span class="hljs-params">title: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/conversations'</span>, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'POST'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">body</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({ title })
      })
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> conversation = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>()
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">conversations</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(conversation)
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentConversationId</span> = conversation.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>
    }
  }
})
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- ✅ 组件中使用 --&gt;
&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
import { useChatStore } from '@/stores/chat'
import { useChatStream } from '@/composables/useChatStream'

const chatStore = useChatStore()

// 流式逻辑用 Composable
const { startStream, stopStream, isStreaming } = useChatStream({
  onChunk: (chunk) =&gt; {
    // 更新消息内容
  },
  onComplete: () =&gt; {
    // 更新 Store
    chatStore.updateTokenUsage(...)
  },
  onError: (error) =&gt; {
    console.error(error)
  }
})

// 全局状态用 Pinia
const conversations = computed(() =&gt; chatStore.conversations)
const currentConversation = computed(() =&gt; chatStore.currentConversation)
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>架构原则：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Composable</strong>：组件内逻辑、复杂交互、外部连接（WebSocket/SSE）</li>
<li><strong>Pinia</strong>：全局状态、持久化数据、跨组件共享</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-9">2.3 难点三：Markdown 内容渲染</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong>
AI 生成的内容包含 Markdown，需要：</p>
<ul>
<li>代码高亮</li>
<li>数学公式（LaTeX）</li>
<li>表格、列表</li>
<li>安全的 HTML 渲染（防 XSS）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>初期方案：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- ❌ 问题：每次渲染都重新解析 Markdown --&gt;
&lt;script setup&gt;
import { marked } from 'marked'
import DOMPurify from 'dompurify'

const props = defineProps({
  content: String
})

const html = computed(() =&gt; {
  const md = marked.parse(props.content)
  return DOMPurify.sanitize(md)
})
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div v-html="html" /&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>长文本解析慢</li>
<li>代码块没有高亮</li>
<li>没有 Vue 组件集成</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>最终方案：自定义 Markdown 组件</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- components/AIMarkdown.vue --&gt;
&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
import { computed } from 'vue'
import markdownit from 'markdown-it'
import hljs from 'highlight.js'
import DOMPurify from 'dompurify'

// 自定义代码块渲染
const md = markdownit({
  highlight: (str, lang) =&gt; {
    if (lang &amp;&amp; hljs.getLanguage(lang)) {
      try {
        return `&lt;pre class="hljs"&gt;&lt;code&gt;${
          hljs.highlight(str, { language: lang }).value
        }&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;`
      } catch {}
    }
    return `&lt;pre class="hljs"&gt;&lt;code&gt;${md.utils.escapeHtml(str)}&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;`
  }
})

// 支持数学公式
md.use(require('markdown-it-katex'))

const props = defineProps&lt;{
  content: string
}&gt;()

const html = computed(() =&gt; {
  const rendered = md.render(props.content)
  return DOMPurify.sanitize(rendered, {
    ADD_TAGS: ['iframe'],
    ADD_ATTR: ['src', 'allow', 'allowfullscreen']
  })
})
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="ai-markdown" v-html="html" /&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;style scoped&gt;
.ai-markdown {
  :deep(pre) {
    background: #1e1e1e;
    padding: 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  
  :deep(code) {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  
  :deep(table) {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    width: 100%;
  }
  
  :deep(th), :deep(td) {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    padding: 8px;
  }
}
&lt;/style&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>性能优化：缓存解析结果</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// composables/useMarkdownCache.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref, watch } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">LRUCache</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'lru-cache'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// LRU 缓存，最多存 100 个解析结果</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cache = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">LRUCache</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt;({ <span class="hljs-attr">max</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100</span> })

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useMarkdownCache</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cachedHtml = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-string">''</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cacheKey = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-string">''</span>)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(<span class="hljs-params">content: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 检查缓存</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (cache.<span class="hljs-title function_">has</span>(content)) {
      cachedHtml.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = cache.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(content)!
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 解析并缓存</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> html = md.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(content)
    cache.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(content, html)
    cachedHtml.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = html
    cacheKey.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = content
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    cachedHtml,
    parse
  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">2.4 难点四：长对话列表虚拟滚动</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong>
对话超过 100 条后，列表明显卡顿。</p>
<p><strong>初期方案：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- ❌ 问题：所有消息都渲染 --&gt;
&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="message-list"&gt;
    &lt;MessageItem
      v-for="msg in messages"
      :key="msg.id"
      :message="msg"
    /&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>性能测试：</strong></p>

























<table><thead><tr><th>消息数量</th><th>渲染时间</th><th>FPS</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>50 条</td><td>25ms</td><td>60</td></tr><tr><td>200 条</td><td>150ms</td><td>30</td></tr><tr><td>500 条</td><td>500ms</td><td>15</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>解决方案：vue-virtual-scroller</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- ✅ 只渲染可见区域 --&gt;
&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;RecycleScroller
    class="message-list"
    :items="messages"
    :item-size="100"
    key-field="id"
  &gt;
    &lt;template #default="{ item }"&gt;
      &lt;MessageItem :message="item" /&gt;
    &lt;/template&gt;
  &lt;/RecycleScroller&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
import { RecycleScroller } from 'vue-virtual-scroller'
import 'vue-virtual-scroller/dist/vue-virtual-scroller.css'
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;style scoped&gt;
.message-list {
  height: 600px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
&lt;/style&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>动态高度支持：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- 如果消息高度不固定 --&gt;
&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;DynamicScroller
    :items="messages"
    :min-item-size="50"
    key-field="id"
  &gt;
    &lt;template #default="{ item, index, active }"&gt;
      &lt;DynamicScrollerItem
        :item="item"
        :active="active"
        :size-dependencies="[item.content]"
      &gt;
        &lt;MessageItem :message="item" /&gt;
      &lt;/DynamicScrollerItem&gt;
    &lt;/template&gt;
  &lt;/DynamicScroller&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
import { DynamicScroller, DynamicScrollerItem } from 'vue-virtual-scroller'
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>性能提升：</strong></p>





























<table><thead><tr><th>指标</th><th>优化前</th><th>优化后</th><th>提升</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>500 条渲染</td><td>500ms</td><td>30ms</td><td>16 倍</td></tr><tr><td>滚动 FPS</td><td>15fps</td><td>60fps</td><td>流畅</td></tr><tr><td>内存占用</td><td>300MB</td><td>50MB</td><td>6 倍</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-11">2.5 难点五：WebSocket 连接管理</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong>
在 Vue 组件中直接使用 WebSocket，容易忘记清理：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 问题：组件销毁后连接还在</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ws = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'ws://localhost:8080'</span>)
ws.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理消息</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解决方案：用 Composable 封装</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// composables/useWebSocket.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref, onUnmounted } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UseWebSocketOptions</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  onMessage?: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">data: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
  onOpen?: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
  onClose?: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
  onError?: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">error: Event</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
  reconnectDelay?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
  maxReconnectAttempts?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useWebSocket</span>(<span class="hljs-params">options: UseWebSocketOptions</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
    url,
    onMessage,
    onOpen,
    onClose,
    onError,
    reconnectDelay = <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>,
    maxReconnectAttempts = <span class="hljs-number">5</span>
  } = options

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isConnected = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isConnecting = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> error = ref&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">Event</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>)
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ws</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> reconnectAttempts = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">reconnectTimer</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">connect</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isConnecting.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
    
    isConnecting.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
    
    ws = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span>(url)

    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onopen</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      isConnected.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
      isConnecting.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
      reconnectAttempts = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
      onOpen?.()
    }

    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(event.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>)
        onMessage?.(data)
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> {
        onMessage?.(event.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>)
      }
    }

    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onclose</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      isConnected.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
      isConnecting.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
      onClose?.()
      
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 自动重连</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (reconnectAttempts &lt; maxReconnectAttempts) {
        reconnectAttempts++
        reconnectTimer = <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(connect, reconnectDelay * reconnectAttempts)
      }
    }

    ws.<span class="hljs-property">onerror</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = e
      onError?.(e)
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (reconnectTimer) {
      <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(reconnectTimer)
      reconnectTimer = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ws) {
      ws.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>()
      ws = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">send</span>(<span class="hljs-params">data: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ws &amp;&amp; isConnected.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>) {
      ws.<span class="hljs-title function_">send</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(data))
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 组件卸载时自动断开</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">onUnmounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>()
  })

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    isConnected,
    isConnecting,
    error,
    connect,
    disconnect,
    send
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>组件中使用：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
const { isConnected, send, error } = useWebSocket({
  url: 'ws://localhost:8080/chat',
  onMessage: (data) =&gt; {
    console.log('收到消息:', data)
  },
  onError: (e) =&gt; {
    console.error('连接错误:', e)
  }
})

function sendMessage(content: string) {
  send({ type: 'message', content })
}
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">三、实战案例：AI 对话组件完整实现</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-13">3.1 组件结构</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">src/
├── components/
│   ├── chat/
│   │   ├── ChatContainer.vue      <span class="hljs-comment"># 主容器</span>
│   │   ├── MessageList.vue        <span class="hljs-comment"># 消息列表（虚拟滚动）</span>
│   │   ├── MessageItem.vue        <span class="hljs-comment"># 单条消息</span>
│   │   ├── ChatInput.vue          <span class="hljs-comment"># 输入框</span>
│   │   └── AIMarkdown.vue         <span class="hljs-comment"># Markdown 渲染</span>
│   └── common/
│       ├── LoadingSpinner.vue     <span class="hljs-comment"># 加载动画</span>
│       └── ErrorBanner.vue        <span class="hljs-comment"># 错误提示</span>
├── composables/
│   ├── useChatStream.ts           <span class="hljs-comment"># 流式响应</span>
│   ├── useWebSocket.ts            <span class="hljs-comment"># WebSocket 连接</span>
│   └── useMarkdownCache.ts        <span class="hljs-comment"># Markdown 缓存</span>
├── stores/
│   └── chat.ts                    <span class="hljs-comment"># Pinia Store</span>
└── types/
    └── chat.ts                    <span class="hljs-comment"># TypeScript 类型定义</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-14">3.2 核心组件代码</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- components/chat/ChatContainer.vue --&gt;
&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
import { ref, computed, nextTick } from 'vue'
import { useChatStore } from '@/stores/chat'
import { useChatStream } from '@/composables/useChatStream'
import MessageList from './MessageList.vue'
import ChatInput from './ChatInput.vue'
import AIMarkdown from './AIMarkdown.vue'

const chatStore = useChatStore()
const messagesContainer = ref&lt;HTMLElement | null&gt;(null)

// 流式响应
const { startStream, stopStream, isStreaming, error } = useChatStream({
  onChunk: (chunk) =&gt; {
    // 更新最后一条消息
    updateLastMessage(chunk)
  },
  onComplete: () =&gt; {
    // 更新 Token 使用量
    chatStore.updateTokenUsage()
  },
  onError: (err) =&gt; {
    console.error('流式错误:', err)
  }
})

// 发送消息
async function handleSend(content: string) {
  // 添加用户消息
  chatStore.addMessage({
    role: 'user',
    content,
    timestamp: Date.now()
  })

  // 开始流式请求
  startStream('/api/chat/stream', {
    message: content,
    conversationId: chatStore.currentConversationId
  })

  // 滚动到底部
  await nextTick()
  scrollToBottom()
}

// 停止生成
function handleStop() {
  stopStream()
}

// 滚动到底部
function scrollToBottom() {
  if (messagesContainer.value) {
    messagesContainer.value.scrollTop = messagesContainer.value.scrollHeight
  }
}

// 计算属性
const messages = computed(() =&gt; chatStore.currentMessages)
const isLoading = computed(() =&gt; isStreaming.value)
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="chat-container"&gt;
    &lt;!-- 消息列表 --&gt;
    &lt;MessageList
      ref="messagesContainer"
      :messages="messages"
    /&gt;

    &lt;!-- 错误提示 --&gt;
    &lt;ErrorBanner v-if="error" :message="error.message" /&gt;

    &lt;!-- 输入框 --&gt;
    &lt;ChatInput
      :disabled="isLoading"
      @send="handleSend"
      @stop="handleStop"
      :show-stop="isLoading"
    /&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;style scoped&gt;
.chat-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
&lt;/style&gt;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">四、性能优化总结</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-16">4.1 关键优化手段</h4>



































<table><thead><tr><th>优化项</th><th>方案</th><th>效果</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>响应式优化</td><td>shallowRef + triggerRef</td><td>渲染时间减少 70%</td></tr><tr><td>列表渲染</td><td>vue-virtual-scroller</td><td>500 条消息 60fps</td></tr><tr><td>Markdown 解析</td><td>LRU 缓存</td><td>重复内容不重新解析</td></tr><tr><td>WebSocket</td><td>Composable 封装</td><td>自动清理，无内存泄漏</td></tr><tr><td>状态管理</td><td>Pinia + Composable 分离</td><td>代码可维护性提升</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-17">4.2 性能指标对比</h4>









































<table><thead><tr><th>指标</th><th>优化前</th><th>优化后</th><th>提升</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>首屏加载</td><td>2.5s</td><td>0.8s</td><td>3 倍</td></tr><tr><td>消息渲染（100 条）</td><td>80ms</td><td>15ms</td><td>5 倍</td></tr><tr><td>滚动 FPS</td><td>30fps</td><td>60fps</td><td>流畅</td></tr><tr><td>内存占用</td><td>300MB</td><td>80MB</td><td>4 倍</td></tr><tr><td>WebSocket 重连</td><td>手动</td><td>自动指数退避</td><td>稳定</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">五、踩过的坑与教训</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-19">坑一：ref 和 shallowRef 混用</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> messages = ref&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">Message</span>[]&gt;([]) <span class="hljs-comment">// 深度监听</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> temp = shallowRef&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">Message</span>[]&gt;([]) <span class="hljs-comment">// 浅监听</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 混用导致响应式行为不一致</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>教训：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>数组/对象用 <code>shallowRef</code></li>
<li>基本类型用 <code>ref</code></li>
<li>统一团队规范</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-20">坑二：Composable 中忘记 onUnmounted</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 忘记清理，导致内存泄漏</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useWebSocket</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ws = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebSocket</span>(url)
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 没有 onUnmounted 清理</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>教训：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>所有外部资源都要在 onUnmounted 中清理</li>
<li>用 ESLint 规则强制检查</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-21">坑三：Pinia Store 中直接修改 state</h4>
<p><strong>问题：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 绕过 actions 直接修改，无法追踪</span>
chatStore.<span class="hljs-property">messages</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(newMessage)
</code></pre>
<p><strong>教训：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>所有状态修改通过 actions</li>
<li>用 Pinia 插件添加调试日志</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-22">六、给 Vue 开发者的建议</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-23">建议 1：Composition API 更适合 AI 产品</h4>
<p>Options API 适合传统 CRUD，但 AI 产品的复杂交互用 Composition API 更灵活：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Composition API 可以轻松组合多个逻辑</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { isConnected, send } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useWebSocket</span>(...)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { isStreaming, startStream } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useChatStream</span>(...)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { cachedHtml, parse } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useMarkdownCache</span>(...)
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-24">建议 2：TypeScript 是必须的</h4>
<p>AI 产品的数据结构复杂，TypeScript 能避免很多错误：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Message</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'user'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'assistant'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'system'</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">content</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">timestamp</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
  metadata?: {
    tokenUsage?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
    model?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-25">建议 3：不要过度优化</h4>
<ul>
<li>简单场景用 <code>ref</code> 就够了</li>
<li>虚拟滚动在消息超过 100 条时再考虑</li>
<li>先保证功能正确，再优化性能</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-26">七、总结</h3>
<p>从传统 Vue 开发到 AI 产品前端，我最大的收获是：</p>
<p><strong>技术层面：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Vue3 的 Composition API 非常适合 AI 产品的复杂交互</li>
<li>shallowRef + triggerRef 是流式响应的最佳搭档</li>
<li>虚拟滚动是长列表的必备技能</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>架构层面：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Pinia 管理全局状态，Composable 管理组件逻辑</li>
<li>WebSocket/SSE 连接一定要封装，自动清理</li>
<li>TypeScript 类型定义要尽早做</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>心态层面：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>AI 前端开发 = 传统前端 + 流式处理 + 状态管理</li>
<li>不要怕踩坑，每个坑都是学习机会</li>
<li>保持学习，AI 技术迭代很快</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-27">互动话题</h3>
<ol>
<li>你在 Vue + AI 开发中遇到过哪些坑？</li>
<li>对于流式响应，你有什么优化方案？</li>
<li>作为 Vue 开发者，你觉得 AI 产品最难的是什么？</li>
</ol>
